title: glob
description: List task-workspace file paths matching one glob via kernel-dispatched ripgrep --files (standalone-v1; ADR-0039 §10). Runs as a policy-classified process effect under the task sandbox profile with no shell, environment injection, network, or secrets. Returns bounded path lists and reports truncation with total_found when capped.

pattern.description: Glob pattern (ripgrep -g syntax), e.g. 'src/**/*.ts'. Must not contain control delimiters.

path.description: Workspace-relative search root. Defaults to the workspace root.

max_results.description: Maximum paths returned in the model-visible projection. Excess paths are reported as truncated with total_found.
